items.title: Room Discovery and Booking
items.description: Users can find available study rooms and create a booking that respects capacity, time and conflict rules.

items.title: Sign in with college account
items.description: As a student or staff member, I want to sign in with my existing college account, so that I can access the booking system without creating a new credential.

criteria.text: When a valid college credential is entered, the user is authenticated and taken to the room search screen.

citations.quote: Students and staff sign in with their existing college account

items.title: View room availability
items.description: As a user, I want to see which rooms are free for a selected date, time and capacity, so that I can choose an appropriate room.

criteria.text: When a date, time range and capacity are entered, the system lists all rooms that are not already booked or blocked.

citations.quote: A user can search rooms by date, time and capacity

criteria.text: If two users try to book the same free slot, the second attempt is rejected (see overlapping rule).

citations.quote: reject an overlapping booking for the same room

items.title: Create a one‑off booking
items.description: As a user, I want to book a single room for a specific time slot, so that I have a reserved space for my study session.

criteria.text: When a user selects a room and a time slot within the allowed length, the booking is stored and the slot becomes unavailable to others.

citations.quote: book an individual one‑off slot

criteria.text: If the requested duration exceeds the agreed maximum (3 h or 4 h), the system shows an error message.

open_questions: What is the final maximum booking length – 3 hours or 4 hours?

items.title: Block a room for maintenance
items.description: As Facilities staff, I want to block a room for maintenance, so that it cannot be booked during that period.

criteria.text: When a Facilities user marks a room as blocked for a time range, the room no longer appears in availability searches for that range.

citations.quote: The Facilities Office can block a room for maintenance

items.title: Facilities view of all bookings
items.description: As Facilities staff, I want a single view of all bookings, so that I can manage room usage and see who booked each room.

criteria.text: When a Facilities user opens the admin dashboard, they see a list of all bookings with user identifiers.

citations.quote: single view of all bookings
my office needs to see who booked each room

criteria.text: Student users see only that a room is taken, not the name of the booker.

citations.quote: Students should only see that a room is taken, not who took it

items.title: Booking Policy Decisions
items.description: Open policy questions around cancellations, no‑shows and maximum booking length.

items.title: Define cancellation and no‑show rules
items.description: As Facilities staff, I want clear rules for cancellations and no‑shows, so that the system can enforce them.

criteria.text: When a user attempts to cancel a booking, the system checks the configured cancellation window and either allows the cancellation or shows a refusal message.

citations.quote: We need a rule for no‑shows, and for how late someone can cancel

criteria.text: When a booking end time passes without the user checking in, the system flags the booking as a no‑show.

citations.quote: What happens if a student books a room and doesn't turn up?

open_questions: What is the allowed cancellation window?
What penalty or action applies to no‑shows?

questions.subject: Maximum booking length
questions.question: Should the system allow bookings up to 4 hours as in the brief, or limit them to 3 hours as requested by Facilities?
questions.why_it_matters: The allowed duration determines validation logic and room utilization.

citations.quote: A booking can last up to 4 hours
three hours is the most I want for a single booking

questions.subject: Cancellation and no‑show policy
questions.question: What cancellation window and no‑show handling rules should be applied to first‑release bookings?
questions.why_it_matters: These rules are needed for the system to enforce fair usage and to reduce empty rooms.

citations.quote: We have not yet agreed what happens when someone cannot attend a booking
What happens if a student books a room and doesn't turn up?
We need a rule for no‑shows, and for how late someone can cancel

items.title: User Access & Booking
items.description: Features that let students and staff discover and reserve study rooms.

items.title: Facilities Management
items.description: Capabilities required by the Facilities Office to control and monitor room usage.

items.title: Sign‑in with college account
items.description: As a student or staff member, I want to sign in with my existing college account, so that I can access the booking system securely.

criteria.text: When a user enters valid college credentials, they are logged in and taken to the room‑search screen.

citations.quote: Students and staff sign in with their existing college account

items.title: Search and view available rooms
items.description: As a user, I want to search rooms by date, time and capacity, so that I can find a suitable free room.

criteria.text: When a user specifies date, time range and capacity, the system lists all rooms that are free for that slot.

citations.quote: A user can search rooms by date, time and capacity

criteria.text: The list shows each room’s name, capacity and “available” status without revealing who booked it.

citations.quote: Students should only see that a room is taken, not who took it

items.title: Book a room for up to four hours
items.description: As a user, I want to book a room for up to 4 hours, so that I can reserve it for my study session.

criteria.text: When a user selects a free room and chooses a start time and a duration ≤ 4 hours, the booking is created and shown in their personal schedule.

citations.quote: A booking can last up to 4 hours

criteria.text: If the requested slot overlaps an existing booking for the same room, the system rejects the request and displays an overlap error.

citations.quote: reject an overlapping booking for the same room

items.title: Block rooms for maintenance
items.description: As Facilities staff, I want to block a room for maintenance, so that it cannot be booked during that period.

criteria.text: When a Facilities user marks a room as “maintenance” for a date‑time range, the room no longer appears in search results for that range.

citations.quote: The Facilities Office can block a room for maintenance

items.title: Single view of all bookings
items.description: As Facilities staff, I want a single view of all bookings, so that I can manage room utilisation.

criteria.text: When a Facilities user opens the admin dashboard, a calendar grid shows every room with all current bookings.

citations.quote: Give the Facilities Office a single view of all bookings

items.title: Privacy of booking holder
items.description: As a student or staff member, I want to see that a room is taken without seeing who booked it, so that privacy is preserved.

criteria.text: In search results and the public calendar, a booked room is marked “occupied” but does not display the user’s name or ID.

citations.quote: Students should only see that a room is taken, not who took it

items.title: Prevent double bookings
items.description: As the system, I must ensure no two bookings overlap for the same room, so that double bookings are eliminated.

criteria.text: When two users attempt overlapping bookings for the same room, the second request is rejected with a clear “room already booked” message.

citations.quote: double bookings happen several times a week
reject an overlapping booking for the same room
